turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Please send your order number (for example, SC-1007) and the email address used for the order so I can look up the delivery and tracking link.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
I can’t look up orders by name. I can only check delivery details with the order number and the email address used for the order.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share or confirm any order details without the order number and the email address used for the order.
